archive.validation: Strict version1 discriminated payload kinds account/policy/media_quote/execution_session; canonicalJson + hashCanonicalJson verified on insert AND load. Reject noncanonical payload, wrong hash/version, nonfinite or unsafe UTC, future observations, invalid/expired bounds. Max256KiB each artifact; max1MiB aggregate draft. Equal exact inserts replay, conflicting IDs/content fail. No arbitrary path/URL reads or runtime evidence-directory dependence.

payloads.account: Producer/SDK/adapter versions, authenticated provider+wallet-derived stable accountId, credential generation, local role/session correlation, exact observed/expiry times, sanitized subscription whitelist; raw authentication secrets and PII excluded. AccountEvidence.source identifies versioned producer; reference is sha256:<account-artifact-hash>.
payloads.policy: Reviewed bounded source capture/hash/URL, capturedAt/expiresAt/reviewVersion; explicit exact model ID->family/workflow/allowed-operation/settings registry and applicable coverage/estimate policy. Generic family/prefix matching cannot authorize.
payloads.media_quote: Exact accepted ValidatedMediaRecipe + toMediaQuoteRequest projection, recipe/resultTarget.inputsHash, mediaQuote/BudgetQuote/binding IDs, account/policy artifact hashes, exact model/capability/adapter evidence and liability interpretation. Never reconstruct recipe.
payloads.execution_session: Exact BudgetExecution/requestHash/quote proof reference, fresh worker role/session observation, generation/account identity, current exact model/policy evidence and finite expiry. Quote-time immutable AccountEvidence/binding remain pinned; worker session proof is additional evidence.

archive.atomicity: Producer performs no persistence. Following takes exact recheck, one TX inserts media quote once, proof artifacts/AccountEvidence, BudgetQuote+binding and QuoteProofLink. Any failure rolls all back. Standalone identity/generation observation for budget policy never asserts a quote, authorization or reservation.

generationAndSubmit.stable: CredentialBindingId = durable generationId, shared across roles when authenticated accountId and SHA256 fingerprint of captured high-entropy API key equal current head. Session/appId/role are excluded. Fingerprint computed only from credential actually captured for cached SDK construction; never logged or exposed in routes. Same current account+fingerprint reuses generation. Any change CAS-increments revision and generates new opaque generationId; A->B->A cannot resurrect A's old binding.
generationAndSubmit.compare: Synchronous currentCredentialBindingId checks proven cached session account/fingerprint against durable current head; returns null before authentication, after mismatch/close, or unknown state. Same-client observeAccount refreshes finite session evidence; role restart requires fresh observation but can reuse current generation.
generationAndSubmit.lastGuard: Transport.submit awaits getClient then invokes constructor proof resolver using that exact client's captured session immediately before projects.create, with no await between check and SDK invocation. Composer checks current durable generation as well as archived execution-session proof/reservation. Rotation or cache close after admission cannot submit under a new session using old proof.
generationAndSubmit.raceLimit: Remote acceptance is outside SQLite atomicity. Existing conservative submission_unknown/no resubmit remains after any submit-stage exception; never auto-release reservation without genuine billing/nonacceptance evidence.

Published research is guidance; no reviewed enabled registry is invented here.

SDK estimate is a point estimate, not vendor max. No default margin or Spark smallest-unit conversion; incomplete settings or missing reviewed unit/bound policy => unknown.
